mapper.sql: f.facility_id, f.facility_name, f.category_id, f.address, f.longitude, f.latitude, f.source, f.poi_id, f.status, f.create_time, f.avg_score, f.open_time, f.phone, f.district_id, fc.category_name AS categoryName, fc.category_code AS categoryCode
mapper.select: SELECT FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.facility_id
SELECT FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.facility_id = #{facilityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO facility(facility_name, category_id, address, longitude, latitude, location, source, poi_id, status, avg_score, open_time, phone, district_id) VALUES(#{facilityName}, #{categoryId}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), #{source}, #{poiId}, #{status}, 0, #{openTime}, #{phone}, #{districtId})
mapper.update: UPDATE facility SET facility_name = #{facilityName}, category_id = #{categoryId}, address = #{address}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, location = geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), source = #{source}, poi_id = #{poiId}, status = #{status}, open_time = #{openTime}, phone = #{phone}, district_id = #{districtId} WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
UPDATE facility SET status = 0 WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
mapper.select: DECLARE @point GEOGRAPHY = geography::Point(#{lat}, #{lng}, 4326); DECLARE @buf GEOGRAPHY = @point.STBuffer(#{radiusM}); SELECT , ROUND(f.location.STDistance(@point), 0) AS distance FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND f.location.STIntersects(@buf) = 1 ORDER BY distance

DECLARE @point GEOGRAPHY = geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326); DECLARE @buf GEOGRAPHY = @point.STBuffer(#{radius});
SELECT fc.category_code AS categoryCode, fc.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(f.facility_id) AS facilityCount FROM facility f INNER JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.location.STIntersects(@buf) = 1 AND f.status = 1 GROUP BY fc.category_code, fc.category_name ORDER BY fc.category_code

SELECT FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id
ORDER BY f.facility_id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND f.facility_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' ORDER BY f.facility_id
mapper.update: UPDATE facility SET avg_score = ISNULL((SELECT AVG(score) FROM [evaluation] WHERE object_type = 'facility' AND object_id = #{objectId} AND status = 1), 0) WHERE facility_id = #{objectId}
